description: Model ids accepted by Anthropic's Claude Code CLI on the Anthropic API (the --model flag / settings). Source: Claude Code model configuration docs plus Anthropic's current and legacy Claude model overview; provider-specific Bedrock/Vertex/Foundry ids are intentionally excluded. Newer models carry a minimum CLI version (Opus 5 needs v2.1.219+, Sonnet 5 v2.1.197+, Fable 5 v2.1.170+). claude-mythos-5 is excluded: it is invitation-only via Project Glasswing and is not offered in the model picker.
